verdict.rationale: Mastra offers a hosted Studio and enterprise plans, so a data-training policy or opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documented no-training policy, opt-out control, or data-use commitment. Self-hosting under Apache 2.0 and enterprise RBAC/SSO controls are adjacent features, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
